title: ArcBio Continuous RNA Workflow - Post-PCR Library QC
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Transfer Tapestation reagent to magnetic module
steps.instruction: Using the p20 multi‑channel pipette, dispense the Tapestation reagent into the Tapestation plate positioned on the Magnetic Module.

steps.title: Place Qubit strips on aluminum block
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and prompt the user to place the Qubit 8‑tube Flex Strips onto the Aluminum Block.

steps.title: Transfer 2 µL libraries to Qubit and Tapestation plates
steps.instruction: Using the p20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 2 µL of each library into the corresponding wells of the Qubit 8‑tube Flex Strips and into the Agilent 96‑well Tapestation plate, then mix the contents.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2 µL library to each Qubit strip well
Transfer 2 µL library to each Tapestation plate well

steps.title: Add Qubit solution to strips
steps.instruction: Using the p300 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 198 µL of Qubit solution from the reservoir to each well of the Qubit 8‑tube Flex Strips and mix.
